context.title: Load existing context
context.imperative: Read any existing docs/agents/*, AGENTS.md, and the README/overview. Attest c1.

postconditions.satisfied_by: Read current and historical repo agent context, README, TESTING, docs/DOCUMENTATION, architecture map, and Charter skill references.

intent.title: Capture project intent
intent.imperative: Ask the user the project's overall intent and current development status, unless already given. Record it.

payload.decision: Intent recovered from docs and git history

explore.title: Explore existing code
explore.imperative: If the project has code, briefly explore it to learn what is implemented. Record findings. Skip with reason if greenfield.

postconditions.statement: current implementation understood at a high level
postconditions.satisfied_by: Explored README, TESTING region map, docs/architecture/index.md, and docs/DOCUMENTATION.md. Implementation: SQLite ingestion; compound_prior; evo feature construction; latent_power; sampled runtime; strategy; physics/preprocessing; stale legacy simulation/reporting paths.

interrogate.title: Interrogate doctrine
interrogate.imperative: Synthesize what is known into a handoff (the goal: how the project wants problems approached, special crew rules, posture, standards, terms). Hand it with the charter starting questions to a subagent that invokes constellation-interrogator; integrate the resolved understanding from interrogation.json.

preconditions.satisfied_by: Intent gate complete with recovered project intent.

postconditions.satisfied_by: Subagent interrogation completed; result saved to interrogation.json and integrated into context updates/issues.

rigor.title: Set rigor and prune
rigor.imperative: From the resolved doctrine choose the rigor level: which human checkpoints the project wants. Prune this checklist's document-confirmation checkpoints to match (owner edit), and carry the choice into the engine config.

preconditions.satisfied_by: Doctrine resolved by subagent interrogation as provisional; material rules are role-operable, with archive policy and repo-local engine completion left as open questions.

postconditions.statement: rigor chosen; checklist pruned to it
postconditions.satisfied_by: Rigor set to mixed rigorous durable system: rigorous for DB/evo/physics/report schemas; pragmatic for docs-only and exploratory work. Confirmation checkpoints retained because user asked to go through Charter completely.

orchestrator-context.title: Write ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT
orchestrator-context.imperative: Write docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md (planning, authority, gating, evidence, stop/ask). Confirm it with the user.

preconditions.satisfied_by: Doctrine resolved by interrogation and user policy decisions.

payload.decision: User confirmed Charter policies and allowed continuing with current durable Orchestrator context after adding .agent-work archive/template policy.

crew-context.title: Write CREW_CONTEXT
crew-context.imperative: Write docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md (implementation, verification, review/blocking, stop/report). Confirm it with the user.

payload.decision: User continued Charter pass; Crew context accepted as durable output for implementation, verification, review/blocking, and stop/report.

glossary.title: Write GLOSSARY
glossary.imperative: Write docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md (shared terms only). Confirm it with the user.

payload.decision: User continued Charter pass; Glossary accepted as durable shared terminology output.

engine-config.title: Write engine config
engine-config.imperative: Write docs/agents/engine-config.json (rework cap, rigor checkpoints, rules root, repo guidance). Confirm it with the user.

payload.decision: User continued Charter pass; engine-config accepted after adding recovered doctrine and work-log/template policy.

project-templates.title: Seed project templates
project-templates.imperative: Seed or update .agent-work/templates/ with project-specific template versions where the project needs them (e.g. project review criteria). Skip with reason if none needed.

postconditions.satisfied_by: Seeded/updated non-context workflow templates: CHARTER.template.json, ENGINE_CONFIG.template.json, CHARTER_CHECKLIST legacy stub. Context templates restored and are not required committed artifacts per user policy.

closeout.title: Compile and archive
closeout.imperative: Confirm durable outputs updated, no open questions remain, contradiction pass done. Archive the work area.

postconditions.statement: durable outputs complete; work area archived
postconditions.satisfied_by: Durable outputs updated; no open questions remain; contradiction pass complete; work package archived under .agent-work/archive/2026-05-29-charter-refresh.
